name: scan_repo
description: White-box scan of a local project folder: hardcoded secrets, code-execution sinks, API routes and trust boundaries, runtime versions with known advisories. Offline and read-only. Returns findings with evidence at file:line and confidence labels.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Project folder to scan, relative to the workspace root or absolute inside it. Default: the workspace root.

arguments.name: max_findings
arguments.desc: How many findings to return, most severe first (default 50).

name: scan_url
description: Passive black-box scan of a running web app the user is authorized to test: TLS, security headers, cookies, CORS, exposed files and docs, OpenAPI and auth checks. Sends no attack payloads: profile quick sends no login request, standard sends one POST /api/login with invalid credentials. Only loopback targets, or hosts the user listed with --allow-host when configuring this server, can be scanned.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: http(s) URL of the app, e.g. http://localhost:3000

arguments.name: profile
arguments.desc: quick skips Retire.js and parameter discovery; standard is the full passive scan (default).

arguments.name: max_findings
arguments.desc: How many findings to return, most severe first (default 50).

name: check_dependencies
description: What each npm or Python dependency can do (install scripts, shell, network, eval, credential access), known-malicious packages and typosquats, read offline from the lockfile and installed tree. Read-only.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Project folder to scan, relative to the workspace root or absolute inside it. Default: the workspace root.

arguments.name: max_findings
arguments.desc: How many findings to return, most severe first (default 50).

name: audit_ai_tooling
description: Audit the project's AI agent setup: skills, MCP servers, hooks, permissions, plugins and rule files, for hidden instructions, curl-pipe-shell, unpinned MCP packages, inline secrets and wildcard permissions. Grades A to F. Offline, deterministic, read-only.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Project folder to scan, relative to the workspace root or absolute inside it. Default: the workspace root.

arguments.name: max_findings
arguments.desc: How many findings to return, most severe first (default 50).

name: explain_finding
description: Explain a finding's rule: what it checks, why it matters, how to fix it, effort, whether it is an owner action (rotate a key, change DNS), research references and OWASP MCP/Agentic ids. Pass the `rule` field of a finding (e.g. agents/mcp-unpinned, secrets, headers).

name: runtime_advisories
description: Is the PHP, nginx, Apache, Node.js, Python or OpenSSL an app runs affected by a published advisory, or past end of life? Give a project path (reads Dockerfiles, compose files and version pins) or the response headers you already have (Server, X-Powered-By). Offline.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Project folder to scan, relative to the workspace root or absolute inside it. Default: the workspace root.

arguments.name: max_findings
arguments.desc: How many findings to return, most severe first (default 50).
